correctness.rationale: The antiunitary U K is normalized to SU(2). Its symmetric/skew decomposition gives tr(A²)=2-4b² and Takagi yields exactly s=|<Ax,x>| in [0,a]. For overlap r and t=sqrt(1-r²), the full fixed-x modulus interval is [|rs-t sqrt(1-s²)|,rs+t sqrt(1-s²)]. Elementary global extrema are max(0,bt-ar) and 1 if r<=a, ar+bt otherwise; U(2) connectedness and common-phase rotation fill all directions. Endpoints b=0,1, r=0,1 checked. Independent 15-pair numerical reconstruction confirms witness radii; finite examples not universal proof.
